name: Markdown
description: Renders GitHub-flavored Markdown (tables, task lists, strikethrough, autolinks) with the shared prose styles, and optionally edits it: write and split modes add Write, Preview and Split tabs over a Textarea. Every stack writes the same HTML: Livewire with league/commonmark, React and Vue with the behavior package's renderMarkdown. Raw HTML is escaped and unsafe link and image URLs are dropped.

livewire.name: markdown
capabilities: Rendered on the server with league/commonmark (GFM, html_input escape, allow_unsafe_links off), with no script in preview mode

wire:model on the component binds the source in write and split modes: it goes to the Textarea, and source defaults to the bound property. Use wire:model.live.debounce for a preview that follows typing; with a deferred wire:model, switching to Preview or Split sends the change first
2.x EasyMDE options (config, disk, folder, label, hint and the error props) are removed

react.name: Markdown
capabilities: source with onSourceChange; without a handler the editor keeps its own draft

props.name: source
props.description: The Markdown. In write and split modes it's the Textarea's value.

props.name: mode
props.description: preview renders the Markdown only. write and split add Write, Preview and Split tabs over the source, opening on that tab; split shows the source beside the preview. Emitted as data-mode.

props.name: sanitize
props.description: Escape raw HTML in the source. false keeps an allowlist of formatting tags (kbd, sup, details, …) with safe attributes and escapes every other tag: script-capable markup never renders. Unsafe link and image URLs are dropped either way.

props.name: tabsLabel
props.description: Names the mode tabs. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Markdown mode' ).

props.name: writeLabel
props.description: The Write tab. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Write' ).

props.name: previewLabel
props.description: The Preview tab. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Preview' ).

props.name: splitLabel
props.description: The Split tab. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Split' ).

props.name: editorLabel
props.description: Names the source Textarea. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Markdown source' ).

props.name: outputLabel
props.description: Names the preview region in write and split modes. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Rendered preview' ).

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { preview: '…', editor: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The .apui-markdown root, with data-mode. In preview mode it also carries .apui-prose and holds the rendered Markdown, its line length capped at --apui-measure; in write and split modes it holds the Tabs.

parts.name: editor
parts.description: Holds the source Textarea, in the mono font.

parts.name: preview
parts.description: The rendered Markdown in write and split modes: an .apui-prose region named by outputLabel, on a card surface.

parts.name: split
parts.description: The Split tab's two columns: the editor beside the preview, stacked on narrow screens.

parts.name: task
parts.description: A task-list item: a disabled checkbox and the item's first line in a label.

events.name: source-change
events.description: The source was edited in the Textarea. Setting source doesn't fire it.

keyboard.action: On the mode tabs: move between Write, Preview and Split, following the text direction.
From the selected tab into its panel: the Textarea, or the preview's links.

requirements: Headings keep their levels and tables keep their header cells (th), so the structure reads as written.
Task-list checkboxes are real, disabled checkboxes, named by their item's text through a label.
Raw HTML is escaped, or with sanitize=false filtered to formatting tags; event handlers, styles and unsafe URLs never render.
The mode tabs are design-system Tabs named by tabsLabel; the Textarea is named by editorLabel and the preview region by outputLabel.
Prose text keeps 4.5:1 on every surface; links are underlined, not marked by color alone.
Line length is capped (--apui-measure) for readability; the text reflows at 320px.
Code blocks stay LTR in RTL pages; everything else mirrors.
